children: The Fort Canning upgrade is scheduled to go live on Enjin Blockchain's Relaychain on 09 Nov 2026. Described as the largest upgrade in the blockchain's history, it adds self-expiring NFT loans, scheduled token expiry, verifiable mint limits, and immutable item data.

The additions support NFT and token uses that depend on automatic expiry, verifiable issuance limits, or item data that cannot be changed. If applications use these capabilities, the resulting on-chain activity could increase demand for ENJ to pay transaction fees. The upgrade expands the available functionality, but the evidence does not establish actual adoption or an increase in usage.
